phone.passcodeSession: Open a session with the master passcode

phone.handedTo: This phone is handed over to {name}. {name} signs in now with their Monitor ID and password.
phone.temporaryEnded: The temporary session under the master passcode has ended with the day. Sign in with your own Monitor ID and password: nothing on this phone is lost.

createMonitor.title: Create monitor
createMonitor.needs: Creating a monitor needs a connection and the master passcode.
createMonitor.name: Monitor’s name
createMonitor.phoneHint: Only if the firm keeps one.
createMonitor.incomplete: Give the monitor’s name, a password and the master passcode.

monitorCreated.title: Monitor created
monitorCreated.username: It is their username: they sign in with it and their password.

setup.title: Set up this phone
setup.needs: Setting up the phone for a monitor with no assignment needs the master passcode. It is recorded as an unplanned assignment.

setup.noCheck: This phone holds no check of the master passcode yet, so it can’t be set up with no signal. Find signal and try again.
setup.offline: No signal: setting up on {project}, whose lists this phone holds.

project.title: Which project?
project.closed: That project has closed. Pick another.

work.title: What work?
work.hint: Pick each kind of work they do today.
work.none: Pick at least one kind of work.

site.title: Which site?

payItems.title: Which unit rate work?
payItems.nothing: This project has no unit rate work a monitor picks.

made.title: Phone set up
made.for: Set up for {name} on {project}, as an unplanned assignment.
made.held: Kept on the phone. It goes to the server when the phone finds signal with somebody signed in.
made.notSaved: The server didn’t take it. It stays on the phone, and the back office is told.
made.notHere: This phone holds another project’s lists: {name} signs in with signal to take this one.

setup.handOverNeeds: Handing this phone to another monitor needs the master passcode. The work it holds that isn’t sent yet stays its monitor’s: the phone keeps it apart and sends it.

handOver.title: Does {name} have their own assignment today?
handOver.ownDetail: They sign in and the phone takes it, with signal

photos.full: That’s the most photos a ticket takes.

home.title: Today’s work

noAssignment.SEVERAL_THAT_DAY: More than one assignment today: ask your supervisor.

work.held: This phone holds the lists for {project}.

warning.other: You’ll be signed out in {count} seconds with nothing done.

sync.noLists: This phone holds no lists yet.

what.passcodeUse: A use of the master passcode

underPasscode.AS_MONITOR: Signed in by the master passcode.

turnIn.title: Sync and turn in
turnIn.needs: Turning this phone in needs the master passcode and a connection. It sends everything it holds, its monitor’s and any earlier monitor’s, and every photograph’s file. Only when the server has all of it is the phone erased.

notTurnedIn.title: Not turned in
notTurnedIn.kept: Nothing on this phone was erased.
notTurnedIn.lacks: What the server doesn’t have yet:

unreadable.one: This phone holds 1 record this version of the app can’t read. It stays on the phone, which can’t be turned in until the app is updated to read it.
unreadable.other: This phone holds {count} records this version of the app can’t read. They stay on the phone, which can’t be turned in until the app is updated to read them.

done.title: Phone turned in
done.erased: The server has everything this phone held. The phone is erased: nothing it held can be read.

move.title: Move to another site
move.needs: Moving this phone to another site needs the master passcode. It is recorded as an unplanned assignment at the new site; what was made here keeps this site.
move.offline: No signal: the sites this phone holds for {project}.
move.noLists: This phone holds no lists for the project. Find signal and try again.
move.noCheck: This phone holds no check of the master passcode yet, so it can’t move with no signal. Find signal and try again.
move.notSignedIn: Moving needs a monitor signed in on an assignment.

site.title: Which site now?
site.nothing: This project has no other site.

made.title: Phone moved
made.to: Moved to {site}, as an unplanned assignment.

session.title: A session under the master passcode
session.needs: The master passcode signs in as this phone’s monitor, or opens a temporary session for another monitor, which ends with the day. Every record made in it says so.
session.noLists: With no signal, this needs the lists and login list the phone reads when somebody signs in on it with signal. Find signal and try again.
session.noCheck: This phone holds no check of the master passcode yet. Find signal and try again.
session.offline: No signal: the monitors on this phone’s login list.

monitor.title: Who is signing in?

split.about: A split load is gathered from several properties: one collection for each.
split.piles: A split haul-out is loaded from several piles: one haul-out collection for each pile.

number.none: This phone holds no ticket numbers yet. Sync when you have signal to get a block of them.

open.title: {kind} {number}

open.placeRefused: The phone’s place is off for this app: the ticket is kept without GPS.

roe.title: Which ROE is this load for?
roe.workTitle: Which ROE is this work for?

call.title: Load call
call.about: How full the truck arrived, as a percent of its capacity.
call.haulOutAbout: How full the truck leaves, as a percent of its capacity.
call.pileAbout: How full the truck is with this pile on board, as a percent of its capacity.
call.over: A load call is a whole number from 0 to 100.

count.about: Count the tickets on the load: the number painted on each stump, or each white goods ticket.

weight.title: Scale weight
weight.about: A load like this at {site} is paid by its weight: copy the scale house’s receipt next. No load call is taken.

nothing.title: Nothing more to take
nothing.about: The load call was taken where the haul-out was loaded.

quantity.notHeldHaulOut: This phone doesn’t hold what {site} asks for yet: add the scale receipt if the scale house hands you one. It reads what the site asks for at the next sync with signal.

receipt.about: Copy the receipt the scale house handed over, exactly as it is written.
receipt.addAbout: If the scale house handed over a receipt, you may copy it too.
receipt.sameAbout: A truck and trailer weighed together share one receipt: pick it rather than copying it again.
receipt.weightsAbout: Type each weight the receipt shows and leave out any it doesn’t. Nothing is worked out.
receipt.notANumber: A weight is a number as the receipt shows it, such as 28140 or 14.07.

place.title: Where it was collected
place.noFix: No GPS fix. The ticket is kept without it.
place.notFound: No address found here. Type the street number and name.
place.unanswered: The address couldn’t be looked up. Type the street number and name.

photos.title: Photos
photos.tooLarge: That photo couldn’t be kept: it is empty or too large.

stages.about: Do each part when the work gets there. Leave the ticket between them and open it again from home.
stages.measurePhotoAbout: Photograph the tape on the work, then enter what it reads.

camera.title: Camera
camera.refused: The camera is turned off for this app. Carry on without the photo, or turn the camera on for this app in the phone’s settings.
camera.none: The camera couldn’t be opened. Carry on without the photo.

review.about: Everything you entered, once. Change anything with Back.

crew.title: The crew

crew.photoAbout: Take a photo of the crew at work, with its truck or machine.

howMany.title: How many?
howMany.notWhole: A count is a whole number here.

measure.about: At chest height, before it’s cut.

stump.title: The stump’s diameter

stump.exposedTitle: Is half or more of the root ball exposed?

items.notANumber: Each is a number, or left empty.
